title: AGM X5
hero_summary: Focused on showcasing the unique design of AGM X5 coupled with the restrains of the pandemic meant that we couldn't travel to shoot on location. So we got creative and brought elements of nature into the confinement of our studio.

narrative_sections.content: The video utilised visual similarities found in nature and AGM X5 to showcase the unique features of the phone and the harmony of its design.
